program_narrative: Program RPTPOS00 is a batch program that produces the Daily Position Report. It opens the indexed POSITION-MASTER and TRANSACTION-HISTORY files for input and the sequential REPORT-FILE for output, and stops with return code 12 if any open fails. It writes three header lines (a line of asterisks, the title and the run date), then reads POSITION-MASTER sequentially until end of file and writes one detail line per position with portfolio, description, quantity, current value and the percentage change against the previous value. The transaction-history processing and the summary section call paragraphs (2210, 2220, 2310, 2320, 2330) that are not present in the source, so those steps cannot be traced. Several names used in the logic (END-OF-POSITIONS, WS-ERROR-MESSAGE, POS-DESCRIPTION, POS-CURRENT-VALUE, POS-PREVIOUS-VALUE) are not declared in any registered layout. Finally it closes the three files and returns.

paragraphs.name: 2100-READ-POSITIONS
pseudocode: -- Read every position record and write a detail line for each
SET end_of_positions = TRUE  -- END-OF-POSITIONS: condition name not declared in any registered layout
WHILE NOT end_of_positions DO  -- PERFORM UNTIL (test before)
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
-- Read every position record and write a detail line for each
READ next record from POSITION-MASTER
IF end of file THEN
  SET end_of_positions = TRUE  -- END-OF-POSITIONS: condition name not declared in any registered layout
END IF
WHILE NOT end_of_positions DO  -- PERFORM UNTIL (test before)
  CALL 2110-format-position
  READ next record from POSITION-MASTER
  IF end of file THEN
    SET end_of_positions = TRUE
  END IF
END WHILE
